QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] The Heart-Pounding Recipe for Love
QuestInfo.0: #bDylan#k is going to explain the plan for his ultimate profession of love!
QuestInfo.1:
#bDylan#k says this will be the greatest profession of undying love the world has ever seen! And, lucky person that you are, you get to help by getting some ribbon he can use to disguise the cardiotachometer! Delilah will never see through this clever ruse!

Defeat #rCreeper Scarlion#k in Funky Station <1> and obtain #i4036092#  #b#t4036092##k.
QuestInfo.2: You heard #bDylan's#k plan for his ultimate profession of love!

0.msg:
We need a fancy name befitting such an amazing operation!
Let's see...

#eThe Heart-Pounding Recipe for Love!#n

All right! I'm going to make Delilah's heartbeat go so fast today, she'll think she's turned into a hummingbird! Oh! I should probably show you the device!

1.msg: #i3801185#     Ta-da!! \r\nThis is the #e#bcardiotachometer#k#n... 1000?... 3000!...10000? Ah, well, the important thing to remember is that I had a really hard time getting my hands on it, so it must be some top-notch tech, right? I'll just get Delilah to wear this and check her heartbeat in real time while we're on the rides at Fantasy Theme World. #eI'll profess my love when it's beating quickest#n, and she'll have to fall in love with me!

2.msg: #b(You shoot Dylan a skeptical look but decide to keep your thoughts to yourself.)#k

3.msg: I'm going to disguise this as a pretty ribbon brooch for Delilah. Nothing says love like a bizarre and intricate plan to win her affection, right? The ribbon is right here in my bag...\r\n\r\nOh no! I forgot my bag! Oh well, I didn't really like that design anyway. Some #bribbon#k from #rCreeper Scarlion#k nearby will do. Could you get it for me? I'll take it from there!

yes.0: Hurry! Delilah will be here soon.

no.0: I thought you were a well-known hero. Was Creeper Scarlion too tough for you?

yes.0: Wow! That was quicker than I thought. Good thing I asked you.\nI'll have this made up in no time. Can you talk to me again later?

default.0: You didn't get #b#t4036092##k yet? Delilah is going to be here any minute. Try a bit harder, would you? You can get it from #rCreeper Scarlion#k in Funky Station <1>.
